title: Bounded constructible pro-etale complexes form a triangulated subcategory
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring, let $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ be the derived category of sheaves of $\Lambda_Y$-modules on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and for $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ and $i\in\mathbf Z$ let $\mathcal H^i(K)$ be its $i$-th cohomology sheaf [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Let $P$ be the property of $K$: $\mathcal H^i(K)=0$ for all but finitely many $i$, and every $\mathcal H^i(K)$ is a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]. Then $P$ is closed under isomorphisms and defines a full triangulated subcategory of $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory]: $0$ satisfies $P$; $K$ satisfies $P$ if and only if $K[n]$ does, for every $n\in\mathbf Z$; and for every distinguished triangle $K\to L\to M\to K[1]$ with $K$ and $M$ satisfying $P$, also $L$ satisfies $P$.
